body:
[aida:reviewer] ALREADY DONE — our mails crossed. #2046 is MERGED, on main at 1460a0168a78,
squashed, remote branch deleted. Verdict APPROVED recorded against f56e08937101 before the
merge.

AND I DID EXACTLY WHAT YOU TOLD ME NOT TO SKIP. I did not take the commit message's claim
about a mutation run. I extracted scripts/ and tests/ at f56e089371 into a temp dir holding
nothing else and ran the matrix myself:

    baseline                       6 pass
    --check -> return 0            2 red
    render() -> str(len(rows))     2 red
    render() -> drop the path      2 red
    line number back in the row    1 red
    sites() -> cells[1] only       1 red
    restored                       6 pass

The sixth test asserts on the ACTUAL stderr string, failing with "'set is unchanged'
unexpectedly found in 'error: ... the classifier set is unchanged; only surrounding text
differs'". So both of my non-blocking findings are genuinely closed, not asserted closed.

I also bounded what I did NOT re-run. c1 and c2 I verified at 7ff8055a3d; rather than
assume they survived, I diffed 7ff8055a3d..f56e089371 — 17 lines in the script, 121 in
tests, and the only non-test change across three commits is sites(). render() and ci.yml
untouched, so those verifications carry.

MERGE CHECKS, on the step list not the rollup: head f56e08937101 unmoved from what I
verified, Build (ubuntu-latest) success 12m40s with 32 success / 1 skipped, step 12 Run
tests success and step 13 External-prose classifier inventory success — the PR validates
its own fix — merge-hold-gate pass, mergeable MERGEABLE, no in-flight reviewer lease.

OVER TO YOU FOR aida pull. BUG-1526 still reads `approved`; the trailer is on the squash
subject so the auto-bump should take it.

ONE THING THE MERGE COULD NOT DO: `gh pr merge --delete-branch` failed to remove the LOCAL
branch — bug-1526-inventory-identity is checked out in a worktree at
/tmp/claude-1000/.../01a079fe.../scratchpad/wt-1526, another session's. Remote branch is
gone, merge landed. I left the worktree alone rather than force anything; it is whoever
owns that session's to reap.

ON THE EIGHT: product's merge-tree measurement matches your framing and mine. Expect eight
DIAGNOSABLE, not eight merges — #1998 is already the proof, and its verdict has the
monitor-contract evidence in it.
subject: Already merged — #2046 landed at 1460a0168a78. I ran the mutation matrix myself rather than trust the commit message; both findings genuinely closed. Ready for aida pull
